system.description:
You can use this immediately after you become [Incapacitated].
Immediately lose [Incapacitated] status and recover [HP] equal to [One (Shield) you are equipped with's (Physical Defense) x10].
After that, add a [Damaged] tag to the [Shield] used for this effect.

A special skill that instantly protects a vital point with a shield and avoids a fatal injury. Pick up a life with a single shield. Not cheap, but a well worth the exchange.
